epics.description: Implement caching mechanisms to improve performance on the Marketing site.

stories.description: Identify the specific performance bottlenecks on the Marketing site that could be addressed with caching.
Develop a caching strategy tailored to the content and data usage patterns of the Marketing site.

tasks.description: Implement caching for static content such as images, CSS, and JavaScript files on the Marketing site.
Configure caching for frequently accessed pages on the Marketing site to reduce load times.

epics.description: Enhance the performance of the Shopping site through effective caching mechanisms.

stories.description: Determine the areas within the Shopping site where caching can be utilized to improve speed.
Develop and implement a caching solution that aligns with the data sensitivity and privacy requirements of the Shopping site.

tasks.description: Implement measures to securely cache sensitive data on the Shopping site and prevent accidental exposure.
Configure caching for product listings and details to optimize the Shopping site's performance.

epics.description: Optimize the Account Management site by introducing caching mechanisms for improved responsiveness.

stories.description: Review the data caching requirements for the Account Management site and define the caching strategy.
Implement data caching mechanisms to speed up data retrieval and processing on the Account Management site.

tasks.description: Configure caching for user profiles and account information to reduce database queries on the Account Management site.
Implement security measures to ensure that cached data on the Account Management site is protected and compliant with privacy regulations.
